cohort: 714,326 cephalic, singleton, term pregnancies without previous cesarean section or pregnancy conditions that would qualify for cesarean section
finding: Among patients without medical indication for planned cesarean section, the risks of short-term maternal complications were higher with planned cesarean section than with planned vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Among patients without medical indication for planned cesarean section, the risks of short-term maternal complications were higher with planned cesarean section than with planned vaginal delivery.
